content:
The angles around \(O\) in the upper semicircle must add to \(180^\circ\). Let the central angle of the shaded sector be \(x\). Then

\[
40^\circ+x+45^\circ+25^\circ=180^\circ
\]

\[
x=180^\circ-110^\circ=70^\circ
\]

Because the point is chosen uniformly from the whole disk, the probability is the ratio of the shaded sector’s central angle to the full circle:

\[
\frac{x}{360^\circ}=\frac{70}{360}=\frac{7}{36}
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{7}{36}}
\]
